task.instruction: Design an operating model for regional filter-threshold changes. Assign final approval, evidence access, audit, and emergency rollback. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: Six local teams see complaints and language examples; the central trust team has 2,400 labeled false-positive audits; local teams receive only aggregates.
Each region has a sandbox and signed schema; no cross-region effects occurred for 60 days; rollback takes two minutes.
Central approval median is nine days; seven urgent changes occur per quarter; five missed a four-hour goal.
False-positive rate must be at most 2.0%, complaint rate at most .8%, with daily aggregate audit.
A water district had 600 central pressure audits, no local residual traces, an eight-day valve review, and a signed 2.0-bar operating envelope.
A microgrid operator held 900 local inverter traces, showed no feeder spillover for 60 days, and demonstrated two-minute rollback under a signed limit.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Keep valve review central until districts receive residual traces. Reason: Six hundred central audits cannot substitute for local evidence inside 2.0 bars. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Authorize inverter tuning inside the signed feeder limit. Reason: Nine hundred local traces and two-minute rollback support bounded local authority. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-02].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Authorize valve changes inside the 2.0-bar signed envelope. Reason: Eight-day review creates cost while central audits keep the boundary legible. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Retain central approval for inverter changes this cycle. Reason: Sixty quiet days do not eliminate portfolio review of feeder interactions. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Authorize valve changes inside the 2.0-bar signed envelope. Reason: Eight-day review creates cost while 600 central audits keep the boundary legible. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Retain quarterly feeder review while operators tune locally. Reason: A signed limit and two-minute rollback expose coordination cost across microgrids. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Keep valve review central until districts receive residual traces. Reason: Six hundred central audits cannot substitute for local evidence inside 2.0 bars. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Authorize inverter tuning inside the signed feeder limit. Reason: Nine hundred local traces and two-minute rollback support bounded local authority. Evidence: [ra-s3a-prior-02].
